standard_prerequisites.name: The set-level glueing construction of lemma-glue-sheaves, whose sections over W are the equalizer of the two maps prod F_i(W cap U_i) -> prod F_i(W cap U_i cap U_j)
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the set-level description that gets enriched with structure.

core_obligations: For an open W the glued sections F(W) are the equalizer of the two maps between the products of F_i(W cap U_i) and F_i(W cap U_i cap U_j) (proof lines 5483-5494). In each of the categories envisioned — abelian groups, algebraic structures, O-modules — the equalizer of such a pair of morphisms carries a canonical structure: it is the subobject of the product where the two maps agree, and the transition maps phi_ij are morphisms in the category, so the equalizer is an object of the category whose underlying set is the set-level equalizer (proof lines 5495-5498). Hence the construction of the set-level lemma produces a sheaf of abelian groups, algebraic structures, or O-modules (proof lines 5482-5498).
proof_roadmap: Recall the set-level equalizer description of the glued sections (proof lines 5483-5494).
Enrich the equalizer with the canonical structure in each category (proof lines 5495-5498).
